Himeno Sakatsume ( 坂詰 姫野 , Sakatsume Himeno ; born 3 August 2001) is a Japanese tennis player. She reached a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 132, achieved on 2 February 2026, and a career-high doubles ranking of 344, achieved on 27 April 2025. [ 2 ] Career [ edit ] 2022: WTA debut [ edit ] Sakatsume made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2022 Championnats de Granby , after entering the singles tournament as a lucky loser, but was defeated by Jasmine Paolini in the first round. [ 3 ] 2023: BJK and WTA 500 debuts [ edit ] She made her debut for the Japan Billie Jean King Cup team on 13 April 2023 in a tie against Uzbekistan. She beat Sabrina Olimjanova and registered her first BJK Cup win. [ citation needed ] Having made it through qualifying, Sakatsume reached the second round at the Japan Women's Open with a win over Alexandra Eala , [ 4 ] before losing to third seed Wang Xinyu . [ 5 ] She made her WTA 500 debut at the 2023 Pan Pacific Open as a lucky loser, but lost to Linda Nosková .
